France advances stablecoin tax, eyes self-custodial wallets and exit tax proposals
France’s National Assembly adopted a crypto tax amendment targeting certain stablecoin swaps, while separate proposals on exit taxes and self-custodial wallet reporting remain under consideration.
French lawmakers narrowly approved a new crypto tax amendment on Friday that could make crypto-to-stablecoin swaps taxable events starting in 2027.
France’s National Assembly adopted Amendment I-3898 on Friday, with 38 votes in favor, 37 against and 25 abstentions. The measure was initially introduced as committee amendment I-CF1826 by French MP Nicolas Sansu and adopted on Oct. 7.
The Assembly is scheduled to vote on the first part of the 2027 Finance Bill on Tuesday, according to its official schedule. Other crypto-related proposals remain under consideration, although it is unclear whether each will be debated or voted on that day.
If enacted, the stablecoin amendment would tax certain crypto-to-stablecoin swaps and change how the country calculates crypto capital gains tax.
French National Assembly advances Amendment I-3898 on crypto-to-stablecoin tax swaps. Source: assemblee-nationale.fr
Under the proposal, investors converting their Bitcoin (BTC) or other cryptocurrencies into stablecoins would trigger a tax on the gains, even without converting gains into fiat. The calculation would use the acquisition cost of the sold crypto asset and the weighted average purchasing price.
Related: Deutsche Bank prepares German crypto custody launch, eyes Asia: Report
French lawmakers to discuss crypto exit tax, self-custodial wallet reporting measures
Separately, the Assembly rejected a proposal on Friday to carry forward realized crypto losses for 10 years, with 18 votes in favor, 75 against and 3 abstentions.
French lawmakers are preparing to discuss other crypto-related proposals as part of next year’s budget. Amendment I-CF1822 proposes to extend France’s exit tax regime to cover unrealized gains when taxpayers with aggregate crypto portfolio values exceeding €800,000 ($895,000) transfer their residences abroad.
Lawmakers are also weighing amendment I-2701, which would require individuals to declare the holdings of the self-custodial wallets if their total value exceeded €100,000 ($112,000) in the relevant tax year.
As of Monday, both proposals remain under consideration for the 2027 Finance Bill.

items.author: Cointelegraph by William Suberg
items.content:
Stocks rebound into key tech earnings: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
Analysts expect Bitcoin to retest $80,000 support again as stock markets attempt to recover last week’s losses.
Bitcoin (BTC) starts the third week of October at $82,000 as crypto and stock markets begin a tentative rebound.
Key points:
- South Korea’s KOSPI Composite Index gained nearly 1.8% on Monday after last week’s tech-driven losses.
- Markets have priced out two further interest-rate hikes by the Federal Reserve in 2026, seeing 75% odds of only one 25-basis-point hike by the end of the year.
- Bitcoin delivered a weekly close below key local support after the Coinbase Premium Index hit -0.14, its lowest level since late June.
Asia leads equities bounce ahead of tech earnings
A lighter week of US macro data prints will shift the market’s attention to corporate earnings as stocks rebound from last week’s sell-off. Some 15% of S&P 500 companies are due to report third-quarter earnings figures this week, including SpaceX on Tuesday and Tesla and Meta on Wednesday.
Tech-stock performance remains in focus after a major drawdown last week that began with South Korean markets. The KOSPI Composite Index lost 2.8% on Oct. 12 before dropping to the week’s low of 5,455 on Thursday, bringing the week-to-date losses temporarily to 17%.
KOSPI Composite Index one-day chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
Contagion spread to neighboring Asian markets before US equities began to weaken later in the week. The S&P 500 index finished Friday down 2% for the week.
As in early August, tech stocks saw considerable sell-side pressure amid concerns over AI expenditure plans and the associated debt obligations. In Korea, the threat of competition in semiconductor manufacturing from China exacerbated the downturn.
Warnings of a “Black Monday” event on global stock markets spread through social media over the weekend. The panic, which coincided with the 39th anniversary of the 1987 Black Monday crash, appeared misplaced, with KOSPI gaining 1.8% on Monday and S&P 500 futures 0.7% higher at the time of writing.
S&P 500 futures one-day chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
Commenting on the disconnect between public sentiment and market performance, market commentator The Kobeissi Letter suggested that stocks should outperform based on investor demand. Persistent high US inflation and a global energy crisis have positioned equities for a surge on any potential signs of conditions improving.
“All while the AI Revolution continues to accelerate and many large-cap technology stocks become cheaper on a forward earnings basis, even as their stock prices rise. And in the background, the demand for asset ownership is historically robust,” it summarized in analysis last week.
Kobeissi noted that while tech giants led S&P 500 strength, 80% of index stocks are trading at least 10% below all-time highs.
Fed rate-hike bets cool despite inflation data overshoot
Ahead of the Federal Reserve’s next decision on interest-rate changes on Oct. 28, markets have tempered their expectations on policy tightening.
Data from CME Group’s FedWatch Tool shows 85% odds of rates staying within their current 3.75-4.00% range in October. The Fed’s December meeting, meanwhile, carries just 11% odds of a further pause. Instead, markets see a 75% chance of a 25-basis-point hike, with a 50-basis-point move attracting 13% odds.
Fed target-rate probabilities (screenshot). Source: CME Group
In a discussion with International Monetary Fund Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva last week, Fed chair Kevin Warsh avoided any hints of forward guidance on policy, reinforcing a pledge made at the Jackson Hole economic symposium in August.
“I don’t prejudge meetings. I don’t believe in saying now what I might do at the meetings that we have in the balance of this year,” he said.
Markets, however, interpreted the lack of information as a dovish signal, doubling down on the Fed hiking rates just once more before 2027.
Adopting a cautionary tone, meanwhile, market commentator Mosaic Asset Company saw inflation trends forcing the Fed to avoid easing off, keeping a crypto and risk-asset headwind in place.
“While investors expect the Federal Reserve to hold rates steady at its next meeting later this month, a growing inflation problem will keep favoring tighter monetary policy,” it wrote in analysis on Sunday.
The September print of the US Producer Price Index (PPI) released last week showed the ongoing impact of the Middle East crisis on fuel prices. PPI delivered its largest month-on-month increase since March 2022 at 1.7%.
“Half of the September increase in the index for final demand goods can be traced to prices for gasoline, which jumped 20.3%,” the Bureau of Labor Statistics reported.
Fuel also accounted for more than half of the September increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI), which beat expectations by 0.1% to hit 3.7% year-on-year.
Related: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs shed $549M as October ETH outflows near $1B
BTC price analysis sees more $80,000 support retests
Bitcoin price action completed a weekly candle close below a key support zone of interest between $82,500 and $82,800.
The weekly close came in at $82,000, a move that crypto trader and analyst Rekt Capital warned could spark further retests of the $80,000 mark in the future.
“Such a Weekly Close would position Bitcoin for a potential bearish retest of ~$82500 into new resistance. And if that bearish retest occurs successfully then it could set price up for a drop below $80k within the next few weeks,” he wrote in analysis on X.
BTC/USD one-week chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
Previously, Cointelegraph reported on September’s local high near $87,000 now hosting multiple resistance components, including the 2026 yearly open and its 20-month simple moving average (SMA).
In its latest market overview, onchain analytics platform CryptoQuant flagged declining US investor demand as a reemerging BTC price headwind this month. The Coinbase Premium Index, which measures the difference in price between Coinbase’s and Binance’s BTC/USDT pairs, fell to -0.141 on Oct. 18, its lowest levels since June 30.
“This reading is particularly significant. If the index remains in negative territory, it could indicate insufficient demand to absorb selling pressure, potentially increasing the likelihood of a continued price correction in the short term,” CryptoQuant commented.
Coinbase Premium Index. Source: CryptoQuant
The lack of demand contrasts with BTC/USD holding gains made since the end of June, having bounced from new multiyear lows under $58,000 on July 1.

items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- Zcash full node developer Zakura has proposed "one-time" viewing keys to stop a future quantum computer from linking a user's shielded Zcash payments.
- The fix targets swaps through NEAR Intents, in which the user’s shielded address is posted on NEAR’s public chain.
- Wallets built on Zakura's open-source libraries, such as Vizor, will be able to add the feature in the coming weeks, with hardware wallets to follow.
Zakura, a developer of Zcash full node software, has proposed a way to stop a future quantum computer from linking users' private Zcash payments, in an engineering post by Zakura developer Adam Tucker announced on Sunday.
The approach needs no network upgrade, Zakura said in a tweet introducing what it called "post-quantum unlinkable swaps for Zcash."
Post-quantum unlinkable swaps for Zcash, no network upgrades required.https://t.co/hzBkdo1AHJ
— Zakura (@ZakuraZcash) October 18, 2026
Zcash's shielded transactions hide the sender, recipient and amount. Each shielded account has a single incoming viewing key behind all of its addresses, which its wallet uses to find and decrypt payments sent to any of them.
A classical computer cannot recover that key from an address. But a sufficiently powerful quantum computer running Shor's algorithm could, according to the post, and would then be able to see the value and memo of every payment the account has received and tie them together.
"Until Tachyon ships, there is a glaring hole: a single published shielded address lets a quantum attacker link every payment that address's key has ever received," Tucker wrote, referring to the proposed scalability upgrade for Zcash that its developers say would also deliver full post-quantum privacy.
The biggest risk comes from swaps through NEAR Intents, a cross-chain swap service, according to the post. Each swap out of ZEC writes one of the user's shielded addresses to NEAR's public chain as a refund address, whether or not a refund is ever made. The addresses look different, but they all belong to the same account, so breaking one would expose all of them.
Around $600 million to $700 million had flowed through Zcash's NEAR Intents route by May, Zcash Open Development Lab CEO Josh Swihart said at the time.
Zakura's fix derives a separate incoming viewing key for each address that has to be published, while leaving the account's spending key untouched. A quantum attacker who breaks one posted address would learn only about the payments to that address.
"If a quantum computer ever breaks a posted swap address, it will not be able to link this to any other transaction," Tucker wrote in a Twitter thread.
To stop the extra keys slowing down restores from a seed phrase, the wallet looks up NEAR's payouts using private information retrieval, a technique that lets it query a server without revealing which addresses it is asking about.
Zcash's quantum roadmap
The proposal follows Zakura's plan for quantum-safe transparent addresses earlier this month, which also uses private information retrieval and said post-quantum signature opcodes were expected in Zcash in January. Swihart said in May that Zcash was aiming for full post-quantum status within 12 to 18 months.
Concern over the cryptography that secures crypto wallets is growing, with Ethereum Foundation researcher Justin Drake and Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin warning that AI could break it before quantum computers do.
Wallets using Zakura's open-source libraries, such as Vizor, will be able to integrate the one-time keys for software wallets in the coming weeks, and hardware wallets will follow once their firmware supports it, the post said.
ZEC was trading at $1,165 Monday morning, up 3.6% on the day per Decrypt data.

9 月 23 日，Space Bunny Alpha 匿名登陆 OpenRouter 和 OpenCode，限时免费开放。它支持 100 万 Token 上下文、图片和视频输入，还能调整推理强度，一度登顶两大平台的日调用榜。开发者随后通过分词器指纹和 Token 计数测试，发现它与 MiniMax M 系列高度吻合，但当时官方始终没有确认身份。

事实上，MiniMax 早在 9 月 27 日就开放了 M3.1-Flash-Preview 公测，主打高速推理和编程任务。如今官方 API 文档已出现去掉 Preview 后缀的 MiniMax-M3.1-Flash，支持五档推理强度和工具调用。

分析：比特币复苏面临考验，交易平台储备回升且现货需求再度转负

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，CryptoQuant 认证分析师 XWIN Japan 发文表示，最新链上数据表明，比特币仍存在筑底迹象，但复苏过程并不均衡，交易平台储备回升、现货需求再度转负，且不同规模巨鲸的持仓行为出现分化。

1. 交易平台储备回升： 10 月初，比特币交易平台储备约为 267 万枚，目前升至约 268 万枚，尽管仍低于 1 月水平，但储备上升不一定意味着抛售增加，也可能与托管方式变化有关。

2. 现货需求复苏受阻： 30 日现货需求指标一度接近零，随后再度转负。永续合约需求仍为正，为总需求提供支撑。该指标与此前讨论的表观需求指标不同，两者数值不可直接比较。

3. 不同规模巨鲸持仓分化： 持有 100 至 1,000 枚 BTC 的群体在过去 60 天内仍为净增持，但增持力度低于 9 月下旬峰值；持有 1,000 至 10,000 枚 BTC 的群体净持仓下降幅度已收窄至接近零，而持有超过 10,000 枚 BTC 的群体仍呈净减持状态，表明增持尚未广泛扩散。上述滚动数据包含 10 月以前的活动，也可能受到不同持仓规模群体之间地址转移的影响。

XWIN Japan 认为，低交易平台储备及部分巨鲸持续增持，仍可能为比特币筑底提供支撑。但要实现可持续复苏，还需要现货需求持续转正、买盘吸收重新流入交易平台的 BTC，以及增持行为扩展至更多持仓群体。此外，美国中期选举和货币政策带来的市场预期，也需要转化为实际买盘。

--- Top Comments ---

[joefourier]: My field is primarily audio/vision ML so I don't have any particular domain expertise, but I don't get how you can lump all "time-series" together in one big bucket. My naive understanding is that the way to improve the accuracy is to gain as much joint information as possible. Like: > Known-future covariates. Some drivers of sensor behaviour are known in advance, such as production schedules, planned shutdowns, weather forecasts. Timestral can condition on them to...

[kooi]: My question: What kind of dynamical system observability does Timestral provide? Is it a blackbox y = F(x, params) model for offline use? Can it provide the actual dynamical system equations? Or are you stuck forever querying the Timestral server (which is bad, think about if you're grid system operator doing day ahead, month ahead forecasts, and Timestral goes down) Typically, in linear, non-linear, and NN models, we fit some noisy data to A) An underlying model with unknown parameters ...

[logancbrown]: A lot of misconception around the utility of foundational time series models on HN. Sure, you could train a XGboost model on a time series with holiday or event covariates, but what if you have 10k different series to forecast for?

韩国总统李在明：将采取必要措施使股市正常化

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，据韩联社报道，针对近期股市下跌导致韩国国民年金公团持有的韩国国内股票估值大幅缩水一事，韩国总统李在明 19 日表示：「我们正在持续评估需要采取哪些政策措施来使股市正常化。近期将听取综合报告，并采取必要措施。」李在明表示：「股价大幅上涨后，出现调整是不可避免的，至于调整到什么程度，没有人知道。与过去不同，政府如今很难直接干预金融市场或证券市场，而且这样做也并不可取。」

不过，他指出：「韩国股市被严重低估。造成这一现象的最大原因之一，是市场对透明度和公平性的负面认知尚未彻底消除。」对于市场走势及前景，他表示，政府正在密切关注。他说：「在股市上，不少人总是反复告诉自己『不会跌，不会跌』，结果最终被套牢。我们有必要尽可能减少这种情况。」

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，中东原油出口持续恢复，但飙升的运输与保险成本正大幅挤压亚洲炼油商利润。HiLo Analytics 数据显示，亚洲炼油商平均每桶毛利约 40 美元，扣除约 33 美元运费后，净利润仅剩约 7 美元，运费吞噬约 82% 的毛利；相比之下，美国墨西哥湾沿岸及西北欧炼油商的这一比例仅约 16%。

供应方面，Kpler 数据显示，9 月中东原油出口量回升至每日 1540 万桶，约为战前水平的 90%；亚洲 10 月原油进口量预计达到每日 2350 万桶，为今年 2 月以来最高水平。但伊朗对霍尔木兹海峡油轮的袭击持续推高运费和保险成本，部分航线运输成本已达到战前的数倍。

为吸引亚洲买家，中东产油国被迫大幅下调原油售价，部分折扣高达每桶 30 美元，但以价换量仍难以抵消物流成本压力。若炼油商进一步削减开工率或转向其他原油来源，中东出口复苏可能再度受阻。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra
items.content:
JPMorgan takes JPM Coin to Ethereum for institutional clients: Report
JPMorgan is reportedly expanding its JPM Coin deposit token to Ethereum, allowing institutional clients to make payments and settle tokenized asset transactions.
JPMorgan Chase, the world’s biggest bank by market capitalization, is expanding its JPM Coin deposit token to Ethereum, Bloomberg reported on Monday.
JPM Coin represents US dollar deposits held at JPMorgan and lets eligible clients transfer funds within seconds, around the clock.
Emma Landriault, global head of Kinexys Labs, said crypto companies could use the token for blockchain payments, while financial institutions could use it to settle trades and post collateral.
Landriault said JPMorgan chose Ethereum for its liquidity and existing use among clients. While the tokens are issued on public networks, JPM Coin will remain restricted to approved institutional participants.
The expansion follows JPMorgan’s November 2025 rollout of JPM Coin on Base, an Ethereum layer-2 network built by cryptocurrency exchange Coinbase. At the time, JPMorgan said it planned to support additional public blockchains. In January, JPMorgan announced plans to bring JPM Coin to the Canton Network.
Cointelegraph contacted JPMorgan for additional details but did not receive an immediate response.
Related: Argentine banks testing JPMorgan’s JPM Coin to speed up settlements: Report
items.title: JPMorgan takes JPM Coin to Ethereum for institutional clients: Report

Omarchy作者DHH吐槽中国软件太粗糙：点名微信、支付宝和鸿蒙

动察 Beating AI 快讯，著名开发者 DHH 10 月 17 日在深圳 GOSIM 大会介绍了自己开发的 Linux 桌面系统 Omarchy，随后参加一场超过 500 人报名的开发者聚会。

次日，他刚称赞华为 MateBook Fold 折叠电脑很有未来感，晚上却批评中国软件太粗糙，点名微信、支付宝和鸿蒙。他表示，自己非常欣赏中国的 AI 模型和硬件，但软件设计仍让他困惑。

DHH 随后解释，问题集中在界面美观、操作流程和细节打磨。例如留白不足、边距不统一、页面切换生硬、动画粗糙，以及信息组织混乱。他认为，硅谷大型 App 在这些方面仍明显领先。

有网友反驳，微信和支付宝整合了支付、出行等大量生活服务，减少了用户在不同 App 之间切换的麻烦，界面复杂难以避免。DHH 不认同，认为功能丰富和设计精致完全可以兼顾，超级 App 没理由做得如此粗糙。

评论区还有人指出，国内 App 的复杂程度与商业化有关。开屏摇一摇广告、贷款入口、短视频推荐，正在不断挤占原本的功能界面。一名开发者打比方，这相当于给 X 加上贷款功能，再往 Stripe 里塞一个 TikTok。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
「木头姐」看好存储芯片，美银警告风险资产尚未到抄底时机

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，ARK Invest 创始人凯茜·伍德（Cathie Wood）近日表示，存储芯片已进入买入区间，认为存储价格快速上涨、电子设备销量下滑的影响已部分反映在股价中。与之相反，美银全球研究部首席投资策略师 Michael Hartnett 指出，市场卖出信号结束并不意味着买入时机已经到来，重返风险资产的两大前提目前均未满足。

存储芯片涨价主要受 AI 服务器挤占产能影响，原厂将更多产能转向高带宽内存（HBM）和服务器 DDR5，导致消费级存储供应收紧。TrendForce 数据显示，2026 年第一、第二季度 DRAM 合约价分别环比上涨 90%—95% 和 58%—63%，NAND Flash 合约价分别上涨 55%—60% 和 70%—75%。

存储成本飙升也开始冲击消费电子产业链。报道援引 IDC 数据称，2026 年第三季度全球智能手机出货量同比下降 22% 至 2.553 亿部。存储原厂受益于涨价，终端品牌则面临成本上升与销量承压的双重挑战。

后续需重点关注 DRAM/NAND 合约价涨幅是否继续收窄、手机及 PC 出货降幅能否改善、存储在终端物料成本中的占比是否见顶，以及存储原厂是否将产能重新分配至消费级产品。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372550
items.title: 「木头姐」看好存储芯片，美银警告风险资产尚未到抄底时机

items.content:
Bitcoin, Ether ETFs shed $549M as October ETH outflows near $1B
US spot Ether ETFs recorded around $955 million in October net outflows so far, while Bitcoin funds extended their weekly withdrawal streak to two weeks.
US spot Bitcoin and Ether exchange-traded funds (ETFs) saw $549 million in net outflows last week as investors continued pulling money from two of the largest crypto funds.
Bitcoin ETFs recorded around $229 million in weekly net outflows, while Ether funds posted even higher withdrawals at $320 million, according to SoSoValue data.
The latest withdrawals marked a second consecutive week of losses for Bitcoin ETFs and a third for Ether funds. Outflows slowed from the previous week, when the two recorded $1.22 billion in net outflows.
Spot Ether ETFs have recorded roughly $955 million in net outflows so far in October, more than in any other month this year.
Ether (ETH) fell 5% over the past seven days to around $2,433, while Bitcoin dipped 1.3% to $82,783 at the time of publication, according to CoinGecko data.
Despite the withdrawals, both Bitcoin and Ether ETFs remain in positive territory for 2026, with Bitcoin ETFs attracting roughly $259 million in net inflows year-to-date and Ether ETFs drawing about $610 million.
Solana (SOL) ETFs recorded around $26 million in net withdrawals during the week, followed by Zcash (ZEC) at $19 million and Hyperliquid (HYPE) at $18 million, according to SoSoValue data. XRP and BNB funds saw smaller outflows of $1.8 million and $285,000, respectively.
Related: Bitcoin price steadies around $82K after Fed’s Warsh avoids rate-hike hints
items.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs shed $549M as October ETH outflows near $1B

items.content:
谷歌开源Harness²：让AI自己改进工具链，GLM-5跑分提高11.5分

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Google Research 开源了 Harness²，让 AI Agent 在不重新训练模型的情况下，自动修改系统提示词、记忆、Skills、工具规则，甚至脚本和插件。项目采用 Apache 2.0 协议，支持 OpenCode 和 Codex。

它的核心是让 Agent 自己试错。遇到新任务时，系统会先提出几套改进方案，再让不同版本的 Agent 分别执行，比较它们的表现，最后组合出更合适的方案。

即使没有标准答案，也能根据实际执行过程寻找改进方向。任务结束后，系统还会记住哪些修改有效、为什么有效，下次遇到类似问题时继续参考，而不是每次都从头摸索。

谷歌使用 GLM-5 和 Gemini 3.5 Flash 进行了测试。在 WorkBuddy-Bench 上，GLM-5 搭配 OpenCode，仅经过一轮优化，平均成绩就从 64.2 分提高到 75.7 分，超过未优化的 Gemini 3.5 Flash 的 72.4 分。在法律任务测试中，GLM-5 的部分评分标准通过率也从 59.6% 升至 71.4%。

不过，实验中默认由 Claude Opus 4.8 负责提出和实施改进，GLM-5 和 Gemini 主要负责执行任务，并不是它们完全依靠自己实现了进化。

国内开发者 Joseph Zhou 也展示了 Harness² 接入 Jev 1.14 的实验，称视觉任务表现持续改善。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372535

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，据官方消息，PopDEX 宣布正式开启 Open Beta，用户现可无需邀请码进入平台交易。作为以交易员为核心的去中心化永续合约交易平台，PopDEX 由 Foresight Ventures 孵化并投资 3,000 万美元，致力于通过更低的净交易成本、CLOB 订单簿、链上透明交易、统一账户及多资产市场，为真实交易员提供接近 CEX 的链上交易体验。

与此同时，PopDEX 推出链上交易抽奖机制 MegaPop。首日奖池由团队注入 150,000 USDT，后续平台 40% 的净交易手续费持续进入奖池；每周未抽中的奖金池将自动滚存至下一期，推动奖池随交易活动持续无上限增长。奖励按周以稳定币发放，记录用户交易凭证的同时用户无需等待积分兑换或未来 TGE。

MegaPop 每张参与凭证的中奖机会独立，小额交易员同样有机会获得高等级奖励。开奖结果基于公开 Bitcoin 区块数据生成，公开透明可验证。Open Beta 前六周，符合条件的交易可享受 2 倍参与凭证加速；当累计参与凭证达到 300,000 张后，PopDEX 将再次注池 100,000 USDT。

此前，PopDEX 在 Closed Beta 阶段已完成六轮实际现金奖励发放，并录得超过 4.5B+ 累计交易量及约 70M LP 池规模。平台表示，MegaPop 是其「100% Value Return」理念的首个长期、公开、可验证的产品化机制，未来还将持续通过其他机制以及返佣、社区活动和生态激励等方式向真实贡献者回流价值。

Justin Sun谈「孙学」：本质是博弈论与演化论，帮助普通年轻人实现从零到一

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，波场创始人 Justin Sun 近期在与金明的对谈中表示，「孙学」并非单纯的精致利己主义，而是一套结合时代环境与个人条件、选择利益最大化路径的方法论，本质上是一种博弈论和演化论，旨在帮助普通年轻人实现从零到一。

Justin Sun 称，「孙学」的特点是学习成本低，普通年轻人都可以尝试，但对于自身条件优越、已经在专业领域形成独立见解的人，不一定需要完全照搬。他以自己在 2016 年提出的投资建议为例，称当时曾建议年轻人不要结婚、不要买房，并投资英伟达和特斯拉，认为顺应时代变化能够带来显著的财富增长。

对于如何避免「孙学」过度强调个人利益、助长社会利己主义的问题，Justin Sun 表示，其核心并非简单追求个人利益，而是先了解时代环境，再结合自身情况选择适合自己的发展路径。

此外，Justin Sun 表示，自己会使用 AI 监控身体数据，希望在合理寿命范围内尽可能延长健康生活时间，并有尊严、体面地面对死亡。谈及人生意义时，他称人生是体验的集合，自己会尽可能体验感兴趣的事物，但无法决定他人如何评价自己。

items.content:
Claude Code给智能电视「减肥」：禁用25个应用，桌面内存占用降低57%

动察 Beating AI 快讯，开发者 Mihir Gupta 花了一个下午，让 Claude Code 改造家中卡顿的 TCL 智能电视。这台电视只有 2GB 内存，AI 帮他禁用了 25 个预装应用和后台服务，还将充斥广告的原生桌面换成了自己编写的新界面。桌面的运行内存占用从 192MB 降至 83MB，减少约 57%。

新桌面模仿 Apple TV 的设计，保留常用 App、HDMI 输入和设置入口，还能在 12 张自然风景照片之间自动切换壁纸。整个安装包只有 4.7MB。

操作也不需要 Root 或刷机。用户打开电视的开发者模式后，Claude Code 就能通过 Wi-Fi 和 ADB 连接设备，检查预装软件、备份配置、编写新桌面，并通过截图验证结果。作者已经将代码、Prompt 和恢复脚本全部开源。

这并非第一次有人用 AI 改造电视。9 月初，工程师 Mert Cobanov 就曾用 Claude Code 清理一台使用 4 年的 Android TV。10 月 17 日，开发者 Gathin 又开源了类似项目 tv-vibehack，Gupta 的作品正是受其启发。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372523

Justin Sun：Hyperliquid是本轮周期最大新发现之一，监管或决定CEX是否转向DEX

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，波场创始人 Justin Sun 近期在与金明的 3.5 小时线下对谈中谈及 Hyperliquid，称其是本轮周期成长起来的最大新发现之一，其推出的美股永续合约为行业打开了新的想象空间。不过，随着越来越多项目布局美股永续合约，Hyperliquid 面临的竞争也在加剧。

Justin Sun 还认为，去中心化交易平台（DEX）与中心化交易平台（CEX）的未来竞争，关键在于美国监管机构如何界定 Hyperliquid 的监管边界。如果其能够获得类似 Uniswap 的监管豁免，不排除大量 CEX 转向 DEX 模式，以降低合规成本并获得更大的全球展业空间，这也可能挤压不转型的 CEX。

反之，如果监管要求趋严，Hyperliquid 也将面临较大压力。Hyperliquid 在监管事务及美国本土运营方面的成熟度，尚无法与 Circle 等在岸合规企业相比。因此，DEX 与 CEX 的长期竞争格局，在很大程度上取决于监管机构对新型交易模式的态度及其划定的合规边界。

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，据英国《金融时报》报道，周一，美股开盘有望走高。此前，美股刚刚经历了自去年 4 月特朗普宣布关税政策以来最大的单周跌幅。在亚洲交易时段，以科技股为主的纳斯达克 100 指数期货上涨 1.3%，标普 500 指数期货上涨 0.8%。

分析师指出，在周五因市场担忧人工智能数据中心相关企业的信贷利差扩大而引发抛售潮之后，投资者目前正在重新评估市场形势。这种情绪缓和也支撑了亚洲市场。韩国 KOSPI 指数在经历了上周 11% 的跌幅后，周一上涨了 0.5%。

法巴银行亚洲首席投资官普拉尚特·巴亚尼表示：「我们看到了反弹，因为周末期间伊朗战事并未出现实质性的升级。」巴亚尼补充道，在经历了上周的「去风险」操作后，交易员们在人工智能相关交易上采取了观望态度。日本东证指数（TOPIX）周一早盘一度下跌近 1%，但午后回升，全天基本持平。聚集大量科技股的日经 225 指数则下跌了 0.7%。

items.content:
Zoom adds ‘proof of human’ badges to show you’re not a deepfake
Sam Altman-backed World has rolled out biometric verification badges for Zoom enterprise users, aiming to combat AI deepfake impersonation and fraud.
Zoom enterprise customers will now be able to see “proof of human” badges to verify that people appearing on video calls are real, after a global rollout of biometric identity technology from World.
On Sunday, the Sam Altman-backed project announced that World ID for Zoom is now available in the Zoom Marketplace. The system compares an image captured by the company’s iris-scanning Orb, a live selfie and the participant’s video feed before displaying a Human Badge visible to other meeting participants.
World first announced its Zoom integration in April, when it was undergoing limited beta testing with VanEck Funds. The feature is now available globally to Zoom enterprise customers. World also named Bain Capital, Pantera Capital and other financial firms as initial design partners for its broader identity verification technology.
The rollout follows incidents involving AI-generated impersonation. In 2024, an employee at engineering firm Arup transferred about $25 million after scammers impersonated executives during a video conference.
In February, suspected North Korea-linked hackers used fabricated video feeds in fake Zoom meetings to trick crypto and fintech companies into installing malware.
“World ID for Zoom is designed to protect sensitive, high-stakes conversations by proving that a real and unique human is present,” World said in a statement cited by Fortune.
Related: New AI cybercrime tool targets crypto, bank KYC systems via deepfakes
items.title: Zoom adds ‘proof of human’ badges to show you’re not a deepfake

Bybit CEO：去年年底已通过手续费等收入弥补被盗损失，全球化交易平台扩张黄金期已过

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，Bybit CEO Ben Zhou 近期在接受吴说采访时表示，Bybit 已于去年年底通过手续费等经营收入覆盖此前遭朝鲜黑客攻击造成的损失。他认为，未来仍会有交易平台遭遇黑客攻击，安全体系应以「假设一定会被盗」为前提进行设计。

谈及行业竞争，Ben 认为，全球化交易平台的扩张黄金期已经过去，未来行业将进一步整合，具备牌照和本地运营能力的区域性交易平台仍有发展机会。他透露，Bybit 今年利润同比下滑，股票等传统资产交易业务目前尚不足以弥补加密业务带来的影响。

对于美国市场，Ben 表示，Bybit 仍在等待合适的进入机会，更倾向于与拥有零售用户基础的当地机构合作。未来一年，Bybit 的核心战略将聚焦区域化发展与深度本地化。此外，他还谈及 Bitget 安全事件与 Bybit 被盗事件的区别、AI 在平台内部的大规模应用及其带来的数据安全挑战。

items.content:
大厂AI人才薪酬倒挂：顶尖应届生年包冲500万，老员工职级更高却拿得更少

动察 Beating AI 快讯，雷峰网采访多位猎头发现，国内互联网大厂正在收紧招聘名额，却仍愿意为顶尖 AI 人才打破薪酬限制。猎头透露，今年部分基础模型方向的优秀应届生，年包已达到 200 万元级别。字节 Seed、小红书的最高档报价甚至达到 400 万至 500 万元，百度则在 200 万至 300 万元区间。

高薪抢人正在加剧大厂内部的「薪酬倒挂」。一位互联网从业者透露，部分基础模型员工即使职级较低，收入也已超过更高级别的同事。类似问题早在 2017 年就已出现。一名老工程师回忆，当时身边一位晚一年入职、职级低一级的海归应届生，月薪却比自己高出 1 万元。团队三十多人，一度每月流失约 10%。

但高薪并没有惠及所有 AI 从业者。猎头称，各大厂的应用侧岗位正在收缩，基础模型团队却仍然缺少真正能训练大模型的人。Coding Agent、模型评测、预训练数据和 Agent 基础设施成为新的抢人重点。DeepSeek 近期也在扩招后端开发和 Agent Infra 工程师。相比之下，AI 搜索等方向的招聘热度已经下降。

这场招聘潮的门槛越来越高。企业不只看学历和论文，更看重候选人是否在头部团队实际训练过大规模模型。对真正稀缺的人才，薪酬和职责可以单独谈；普通 AI 求职者面对的却是越来越激烈的竞争。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
South Korea to meet crypto exchanges amid calls for tax delay
Finance officials are reportedly set to meet major crypto exchanges on Tuesday, days after a lawmaker introduced legislation that could push the tax’s start date back two years.
South Korea’s senior finance officials are reportedly set to meet crypto exchanges on Tuesday as calls to postpone a planned cryptocurrency tax are heating up ahead of its scheduled implementation in January.
According to Yonhap, the government is planning to hold a consultation on crypto taxation, with representatives coming from Upbit, Bithumb, Coinone, DigitalX and Gopax, along with executives of the Digital Asset Exchange Alliance, known as DAXA.
Government officials attending include Kwon Dae-young, first vice minister of finance and economy, and Yoo Young-jun, director general for digital financial policy at the Financial Services Commission.
South Korean regulators have delayed the crypto tax three times, with the latest delay pushing the start date to 2027 amid political disagreement and industry pushback over exchange readiness and the threshold level.
An exchange official told Yonhap on Sunday that unresolved transaction rules and limited time to prepare infrastructure supported postponing the tax.
“Standards for different transaction types have not yet been finalized, and time is running short for practical preparations on the infrastructure side,” an exchange official told Yonhap. “There is a shared view in favor of postponing the start of taxation.”
On Friday, Democratic Party of Korea lawmaker Park Min-gyu introduced a bill seeking to postpone the tax until Jan. 1 of the second year after South Korea begins sharing data under OECD’s Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF). With the first exchange expected in 2027, taxation would begin in 2029.
Related: South Korea plans cybersecurity overhaul after attacks hit banks, crypto firms
items.title: South Korea to meet crypto exchanges amid calls for tax delay

韩国金融监管负责人再次就单股杠杆ETF上市致歉

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，据韩国媒体报道，在韩国国会国政监察中，当被问及单股杠杆 ETF 的推出是否影响韩国股市波动时，韩国金融监督院院长李灿镇回答称：「我认为在一定程度上产生了影响。」对于未积极阻止相关产品上市的批评，他表示「深感抱歉」。

19 日，在韩国国会政务委员会对金融监督院进行的国政监察中，国民力量党议员表示：「如果搜索单股杠杆 ETF 上市后的相关新闻，就会发现『黑色星期一』『黑色星期二』『黑色星期三』『黑色星期四』和『黑色星期五』全都有了，整整一周都变成了黑色。您是否认为单股杠杆 ETF 的上市对这种情况产生了影响？」李灿镇回答：「我认为在一定程度上产生了影响。」

随后，当被问及股市波动的其他原因时，李灿镇补充称：「三星电子和 SK 海力士存在严重波动性。」

items.content:
Ansem：Papertrade全新机制可能具有划时代意义，有望重塑高杠杆投机市场

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，加密交易员 Ansem 发文表示，Papertrade 可能成为具有长期发展潜力的创新项目。高杠杆永续合约一直是加密行业盈利能力最强的产品之一，市场对投机交易的需求也将持续存在。Papertrade 支持用户开平仓合成的 1000 倍杠杆头寸，且不会对市场造成实际冲击。其商业模式是将交易者的亏损用于支持链上流动性池（LP），超过一定 LP 规模上限后的亏损则分配给 PAPER 质押者。该平台上线首周向 PAPER 质押者分配的金额已超过 5000 万美元。

传统永续合约 DEX 主要通过交易手续费获取收入，而 Papertrade 尝试直接将交易者的亏损转化为收益来源。由于高杠杆交易的获胜难度较大，理论上交易者的亏损有望长期覆盖盈利者的收益。当 LP 达到一定规模上限后，即使平台盈利者与亏损者的比例逐渐接近 50:50，这种模式仍有其独特优势，因为交易者可以通过质押平台代币分享平台收益，而不只是向平台支付手续费。

此外，Papertrade 的模式未来可能扩展至永续合约以外的投机游戏，包括在线娱乐等领域。如果将 Hyperliquid 比作金融领域的基础设施，Papertrade 有潜力成为互联网高杠杆投机及游戏市场的基础设施。不过，该模式能否持续吸引用户、维持流动性并实现长期发展，仍有待后续市场表现验证。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372500

items.content:
OpenCode遭入侵，OpenAI出手补账：攻击消耗的API额度退还用户

动察 Beating AI 快讯，OpenAI 产品与平台主管 Thibault Sottiaux 表示，团队已与 OpenCode 合作，帮助受影响的 OpenAI API 客户恢复服务，并退还攻击期间被消耗的 API 额度。

此前，OpenCode 披露一套即将停用的旧系统遭入侵，可能泄露用户托管的第三方模型 API 密钥，波及 1.4% 的 Console 用户。攻击者拿到密钥后，就可能冒用用户身份调用付费模型。社区已有用户报告数百美元的异常费用。

除了处理用户损失，OpenAI 还向 OpenCode 提供了 Daybreak Blue 防御权限。此前，OpenCode 联合创始人 Dax Raad 抱怨，团队使用前沿模型调查攻击时，部分请求遭到安全限制。Daybreak Blue 允许经过审核的安全团队在合法防御任务中减少拒答。Dax 随后向 OpenAI 致谢，称 Daybreak 在此次防御中发挥了关键作用，目前仍在持续运行。

Tibo 还提醒其他安全团队，可以提前申请 Daybreak Blue，不必等到遭受攻击才寻求授权。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372498

items.content:
豆包反驳「中国一半算力在造爽剧」：字节只有约10%算力用于视频生成

动察 Beating AI 快讯，豆包公关负责人刘星公开质疑「中国超一半 AI 算力在造爽剧」的说法，直言相关数据「有些不靠谱」。他透露，字节跳动的总算力中，只有约 10% 用于视频生成模型的训练和推理。这个比例还包括模型研发，并非全部拿来制作短剧。

争议源于中文在线今年 6 月披露的一份投资者交流记录。公司称，国内 55% 的 AI Token 消耗来自短剧和视频生成，24% 用于电商营销，软件开发仅占 15%。这组数据最近被重新翻出，经过媒体传播，演变成「中国一半算力在造爽剧」，甚至衍生出「美国造未来，中国造爽剧」的讨论。

但中文在线并未交代这组全国性数据的原始统计机构、样本范围和计算方法。更重要的是，Token 消耗量不等于实际算力消耗，视频生成也不全是短剧。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
Vitalik：以太坊应通过EIP-8288实现通用密码学支持，减少预编译合约需求

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，以太坊联合创始人 Vitalik Buterin 发文表示，将大部分密码学支持放在预编译合约和以太坊虚拟机（EVM）中并非理想方案。由于两者处理的数据通常需要通过调用数据写入以太坊区块，链上数据空间存在限制，即使引入 PeerDAS 和 Blob 机制，实际数据吞吐量达到约 8 MB/s 后仍可能面临压力。

以太坊不应仅被视为一条区块链，而应被视为一台「密码学世界计算机」。对于无需纳入链上数据与执行主流程的计算任务，不应强制将其放入主流程处理。更合适的方案是采用以 EIP-8288 为核心的设计：在客户端完成复杂计算，并生成 STARK 证明，再通过 EIP-8288 的递归聚合机制提交证明。

按照这一思路，链上只需验证计算已完成及其结果，无需直接处理相关原始数据或执行完整计算过程。Vitalik 认为，这将使开发者能够自由使用不同的密码学技术，同时保持以太坊链的轻量化，并减少未来新增预编译合约的需求。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372494

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Character.AI 申请破产前，迪士尼就已经向它的 66 名员工发出工作邀请。其中 56 人已经离职，另有 10 人正在等待工作签证调整。根据破产法院文件，迪士尼预计未来三年为这批员工投入约 1.8 亿美元，包括 3000 万美元留任奖励。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
OpenCode披露云端入侵，团队称持续遭攻击48小时，防守AI半路拒答

动察 Beating AI 快讯，10 月 18 日，OpenCode 披露云端 Console 遭入侵，1.4% 的 Console 用户受到影响，托管在云端的第三方模型 API 密钥可能泄露。随后，联合创始人 Dax Raad 透露，过去 48 小时，攻击者一直在尝试入侵 OpenCode 的系统。

他称，对方有 Agent 全天候发起攻击，团队也需要让防御 Agent 24 小时运转，不断排查漏洞、加固系统。

但 OpenCode 用 AI 调查攻击时，碰到了另一个麻烦。Dax 表示，团队使用的前沿模型起初帮忙完成了不少工作，随后却开始拒绝部分请求。

原因是网络安全调查需要分析真实的攻击代码、漏洞利用方式和恶意指令，这些内容容易触发模型的安全防护，被误判为协助黑客发动攻击。

类似的尴尬此前也发生在 Hugging Face。今年 7 月，该平台遭到 OpenAI 实验性 Agent 入侵。安全团队试图用 Claude 分析约 1.76 万条攻击记录，却频繁遭到拒绝，最后改用本地部署的智谱 GLM-5.2，才解开大量经过加密和混淆的攻击指令。

OpenCode 这次通过 OpenAI 的 Daybreak Blue 缓解了问题。这项权限专门面向经过审核的安全团队，允许模型在分析恶意代码、调查入侵等合法任务中减少拒答。Dax 称，团队几天前恰好提交了申请，10 月 17 日获批，获得权限后情况有所改善。他也明确表示，没有模型公司拒绝提供帮助。

此事引来美国 AI 政策人物 David Sacks 公开批评。他认为，模型公司统一设置的安全限制，可能让防守者反而受到束缚，而攻击者却能通过其他途径获取强大的 AI 能力。他因此主张让安全团队能够自主部署前沿模型，而不是完全依赖模型提供商决定哪些网络安全任务可以执行。

市场担忧主要来自两方面：一是美国 AI 基础设施融资压力持续发酵，CoreWeave 融资能力受到质疑，Anthropic 和 Nscale 的上市预期也有所降温；二是中国 DeepSeek 周末发布新模型更新，称其运行速度更快、资源消耗更低，引发市场对 AI 模型所需存储容量下降、芯片需求可能受到影响的担忧。

韩国综合股价指数（Kospi）上周创下 2008 年 10 月以来最大单周跌幅。周一该指数一度下跌逾 3%，随后收复部分失地；日本日经 225 指数一度下跌 2.3%，台湾加权指数下跌 2%。

Life Asset Management 首席执行官 Kang DaeKwun 表示，目前市场不确定性过高，难以判断韩国股市何时触底，美国企业 AI 项目的融资情况是主要风险之一。他指出，韩国芯片企业的盈利表现仍高度依赖美国企业持续投入 AI 基础设施。本周 Meta、特斯拉等科技巨头的财报，将成为观察 AI 资本开支增长势头的重要窗口。

特朗普支持率跌至33%，美国中期选举前共和党承压

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，距离美国中期选举投票日还有两周，共和党面临严峻的政治形势。根据《华盛顿邮报》、美国广播公司新闻部和益普索联合开展的一项民调，美国总统特朗普的支持率降至新低，而随着通胀压力加剧、选民情绪日益不满，民主党在国会控制权之争中的支持率正在上升。

特朗普的支持率目前为 33%，不支持率为 66%；其中，52% 的受访者表示强烈不支持他的表现。这一支持率较去年同期下降了 8 个百分点，也低于他第一任期内的任何时候。民调还发现，十多年来，民主党首次在经济治理问题上获得了比共和党更高的选民信任度。

这项新民调的整体结果显示，美国选民对总统失去了信心，对特朗普决定对伊朗发动战争深感担忧，并正在承受战争带来的经济影响，尤其是汽油价格上涨对家庭财务的冲击。

items.content:
Allium报告：前三季度稳定币支付规模达4820亿美元，同比增长45%

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，区块链分析公司 Allium 发布的最新报告显示，尽管今年稳定币供应量几乎没有增长，但现有流通稳定币在支付领域的使用频率和交易规模均有所上升。报告指出，2026 年前九个月，稳定币支付规模达到 4820 亿美元，同比增长 45%。

这一增长与稳定币市场整体表现形成鲜明对比。报告数据显示，截至 9 月底，与美元等法定货币挂钩的稳定币总流通市值约为 3050 亿美元，较年初仅增长 0.4%。同期，稳定币支付笔数增长更为显著，同比增长 71%，超过 10 亿笔。这表明，即使市场新增供应有限，稳定币仍在被更频繁地用于交易和支付。

与稳定币挂钩的支付卡也呈现出快速增长。Allium 数据显示，截至 9 月，此类卡片的累计消费金额达到 39 亿美元，是去年同期的 10 倍。其中，金额低于 50 美元的小额消费贡献了卡片交易笔数增量的 84%。

上周早些时候的三项公告，展现了稳定币如何进一步融入全球支付体系。万事达卡（Mastercard）周四宣布，与其于 8 月收购的稳定币基础设施公司 BVNK 推出 Global Money Platform。该平台通过单一接口整合传统货币账户、稳定币余额、货币兑换、银行卡消费及银行转账承兑等功能。Stripe 宣布正与基于区块链的金融服务公司 Plasma 合作开发支付卡，支持美元、欧元、巴西雷亚尔、墨西哥比索和哥伦比亚比索等货币余额，以及符合条件的稳定币。Visa 表示，面向金融科技公司、汇款机构和银行提供支付编排服务的 Inyo Global，已成为首家将 Visa Direct 稳定币预筹资金服务投入商业运营的服务商。

items.content:
贝莱德代币化货币市场基金BUIDL管理资产规模达23亿美元，拟拓展抵押品用途

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，据彭博社报道，全球最大资产管理公司贝莱德正在探索将代币化资产的应用范围从加密市场拓展至传统金融领域，使其不仅能够作为抵押品，还能用于支付。贝莱德正将重点从在区块链网络上发行股票、债券和货币市场基金，转向改善这些资产的转移方式及抵押品用途。通过代币化，投资者可以直接将持有的资产转让给其他投资者，或将其用作交易抵押品，而无需先赎回为现金。

贝莱德也在持续拓展代币化产品的布局。该公司于 2024 年推出的代币化货币市场基金 BUIDL 管理资产规模已增至约 23 亿美元，此后又在美国和欧洲推出相关产品，并于今年 9 月获得批准，可推出一只以港元计价的数字流动性基金。

不过，代币化资产能够在区块链网络上全天候转移，并不意味着其可以随时赎回为现金。国际货币基金组织曾指出，不同平台之间的碎片化以及法律层面的不确定性，是阻碍代币化资产发展的主要因素。国际掉期与衍生工具协会（ISDA）也表示，托管安排、抵押品规则以及跨境法律认可等问题仍有待解决。

贝莱德数字资产团队董事 Nikhil Sharma 表示，早期投资代币化基金的用户主要是加密市场参与者，他们希望在持有稳定币的同时获取收益。他补充称，关键在于建立相关衔接机制，让传统金融机构无需另行搭建独立系统，就能使用代币化产品，预计随着时间推移，相关产品的应用范围将进一步扩大。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
World推出银行版World ID套件，全面开放Zoom深度伪造检测

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，由 OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 联合创立的身份项目 World 宣布，正式推出面向银行和金融机构的 World ID 验证产品。这是该项目首个针对特定行业的定制套件，在 Money20/20 大会上发布。该套件整合了三款产品，包括存储用户「证明」的身份钱包 World ID app，用于确认通话对象是否为真人的 World ID for Zoom，以及可让用户将身份证明委托给 AI 代理的 World ID for Agents（AgentKit）。其中，World ID for Zoom 在 4 月完成有限测试后现已全面开放，其主要开发商 Tools for Humanity 也已加入 Zoom 的独立软件供应商计划。

在落地合作方面，World 表示正与 OpenExchange、Bain Capital、VanEck Funds 和 Outtake 等设计合作伙伴探讨该技术在金融服务中的应用，但未透露具体使用该产品的银行名称及定价。World 指出，随着 AI 普及，企业越来越需要个人提供「证明」以降低欺诈风险。

据德勤预测，美国由 AI 驱动的欺诈损失预计到 2027 年将达到 400 亿美元。目前全球已有超过 1800 万人持有 World 的「人类证明」。此外，其上个月刚推出覆盖 150 多个国家的 World Money 自托管应用，并在 7 月通过 WLD 代币销售筹集了 5250 万美元。

Qubic Attack Drains 1,404 Wallets of Approximately 2.94 Trillion QU, With 87.1% of Stolen Funds Frozen

Layer 1 network Qubic said in a post that between 23:42 UTC on October 17 and 01:26 UTC on October 18, an attacker exploited insufficient randomness in certain wallet seeds to compromise 1,404 wallets and drain approximately 2.94 trillion QU. The vulnerability originated in the seed-generation mechanism, not the Qubic protocol itself.

Qubic halted network transactions at tick 85,371,949. Some 87.1% of the stolen funds remain on the network and are frozen, while the remaining 12.9% was transferred to MEXC, where the receiving account has also been frozen. Other exchanges have suspended QUBIC deposits and withdrawals. Strive CEO：永久做多比特币、做空美元，长期货币贬值不可逆

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，比特币财库公司 Strive 首席执行官 Matt Cole 发文阐述其投资框架。其指出，长期货币供应趋势是评估资本成本的重要参考。过去 55 年以上的历史证明，稀缺资产始终跑赢货币贬值。自 1970 年以来黄金复合增长率为 9.0%，同期 M2 为 6.7%，自全球金融危机以来分别为 9.5% 和 6.3%，自新冠疫情以来更是达到 18.3% 对 6.5%。Cole 认为，比特币作为数字黄金是更优越的价值存储工具，且仍处于早期阶段，随着成熟度提升，其表现应超越黄金。只要长期货币贬值趋势持续、债务危机不断恶化，稀缺资产相对美元的超额收益将不断加速。

针对公司战略，Cole 强调「放大比率」（Amplification Ratio）是 Strive 跑赢比特币的决定性因素，而非资本成本。在不爆仓的前提下建立并维持高放大比率极其困难，多数投资者尚未理解并充分定价 Strive 围绕高比特币放大和高流动性建立的护城河，直到比特币创下可持续的新高才会醒悟。

Cole 还批评了共识投资者仍过度关注资本成本和法币现金流，这如同在贬值压路机前捡硬币。真正理解比特币本位后核心原则便无比清晰：最大化且永久地做空美元、做多比特币。

此外，昨日 Matt Cole 发布比特币持仓数据图，配文称「现在用双倍马力堆积 sats」（Now stacking sats with double the horsepower），暗示将于下周披露 BTC 增持数据。Strive 最近在 10 月 12 日至 10 月 13 日期间再次增持 2,822 枚比特币，平均价格约 83,266 美元每枚。此次增持支付 2.35 亿美元，比特币持仓增至 3.56 万枚。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
Qubic freezes chain after attacker drains 1.4K wallets with weak seeds
Qubic says 87.1% of the stolen funds remain onchain and the rest were frozen at crypto exchange MEXC, as network validators prepare to vote on a recovery plan.
Layer-1 blockchain network Qubic halted operations Sunday after an attacker reportedly exploited weakly generated wallet seeds to drain approximately $1.4 million from more than 1,400 accounts, according to the project.
In a statement on X, Qubic said the network was halted at tick 85,371,949, where it remains paused at the time of writing. Qubic said the vulnerability affected wallet seeds generated using any browser on an iPhone or iPad, Safari on a Mac until Oct. 18, 2026, or the Qubic iOS app before July 2025, leading to 2.94 trillion Qubit (QU) stolen.
“87.1% of the drained funds never left the Qubic network and remain frozen in place,” said Qubic. “The remaining 12.9% was sent to MEXC, whose team froze the receiving account within about an hour.”
The Qubic theft is the latest in a series of attacks tied to weak wallet seeds. In July, Coldcard disclosed that attackers had stolen funds from wallets whose seeds were weakened by a firmware bug. Similar flaws affected Trust Wallet’s browser extension and the Libbitcoin Explorer tool in 2023.
Related: Bitget’s $388M hack pushes Q3 crypto security losses past $1B
Qubic said it has fixed the seed-generation flaw in the latest version of its web wallet.
A GitHub commit for version 4.26.4 shows that Qubic replaced JavaScript’s Math.random() function, which is not suitable for generating cryptographic secrets, with the cryptographically secure crypto.getRandomValues() function when creating wallet seeds.
Qubic said its core team is identifying affected wallets and preparing recovery options for a vote by the network’s Computors, which will decide what happens to the frozen funds. The team said it would publish a full technical report after a recovery plan is settled. It has not announced when the network will restart.
Qubic did not immediately respond to Cointelegraph’s request for comment.
Qubic is a layer-1 blockchain that supports transactions and smart contracts without fees. It is built on Useful Proof of Work (UPoW) – a consensus mechanism that repurposes mining energy to train artificial intelligence. Qubic’s token had a market capitalization of about $62.6 million at the time of writing, according to CoinGecko.
In the third quarter, hacks and exploits accounted for 19% of crypto crime cases but 40% of reported losses, according to AMLBot’s 2026 investigations report, which looked at 250 investigations it opened since the start of the year.
Magazine: Richard Heart caught ‘off-guard,’ QDay gets even closer: Hodler’s Digest

Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin said in an October 9 interview with Balaji Srinivasan at the Network State Conference 2026 that talking directly to AI has become an effective way for him to learn difficult subjects. Anthropic设立公共利益基金：初始承诺5%股份，公司估值上涨将自动追加

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Anthropic 近日宣布设立「Anthropic 公共利益基金」，并承诺初始注入公司 5% 的股份。该基金采用「随公司成长而递增」的机制：在公司估值较基准线每上涨 50% 时，董事会可酌情追加 2% 的股份。该基金注册为全资有限责任公司（LLC）而非传统非营利组织，以便保持捐赠形式的灵活性。Anthropic 明确承诺，基金所持股权绝不用于美国或海外的政治游说与政治捐款。

此举目标以更大规模探索新的公益路径，包括应对 AI 可能引发的劳动力市场冲击（Anthropic 此前已为此投入 2 亿美元）。结合联合创始人承诺捐出的个人 80% 股份及员工配捐计划加上本次注入，预计约 20% 的 Anthropic 总股份将致力于公共利益，若未来达到特定估值里程碑，该比例还将增加。Anthropic 表示，这实质上是将科技公司常用的高管递增薪酬机制，导向了公共利益。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372451

Crypto. com与Novig起诉密苏里州，寻求打破体育事件合约禁令

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，Crypto. com 旗下预测市场交易平台与 Novig 于上周五在联邦法院对密苏里州官员提起诉讼，要求法官禁止该州对其体育事件合约执法。此前，密苏里州总检察长 Catherine Hanaway 于 9 月向包括这两家公司在内的六家平台发出停止函，限其 30 天内停止向该州居民提供体育事件合约，或取得州牌照并缴纳 10% 税负。Crypto. com 的诉讼指出，该信函错误地发给了 Foris DAX, Inc. 而非交易平台本身，且密苏里州宪法仅允许发放两张移动体育预测牌照，目前均已发放完毕，因此取得牌照并非可行选项。

两家平台主张，《商品交易法》赋予了 CFTC「专属管辖权」，并优先于州法律。值得注意的是，同样在 9 月收到停止函的 Kalshi、Polymarket、Robinhood 和 Underdog，截至周日尚未在密苏里州联邦法院提起诉讼；Kalshi 此前正与总检察长办公室进行「持续讨论」。目前美国多个联邦上诉法院对「联邦法是否优先于州监管」存在分歧，第六和第九巡回法院裁定不利于 Kalshi，第三巡回法院则支持 Kalshi。鉴于第八巡回法院（涵盖密苏里州）正在审理爱荷华州 Kalshi 案的同类上诉，Novig 已请求法院在诉讼期间发布初步禁令以维持现状。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372449

items.author: Eric_Gullichsen
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[jMyles]: Whatever else is real or myth with regard to these trolly pranking trademark spats, I think it's pretty reasonable to say that the term "cyberspace" emerged amidst - or at least adjacent to - a lot of LSD and Grateful Dead tapes.  https://w2.eff.org/Misc/Publications/John_Perry_Barlow/HTML/...

[Animats]: I saw that Autodesk VR setup. They had ping-pong working. There was serious thought about how to do CAD work in VR. But it was like trying to do mechanical drawing while wearing oven mitts. Precision work with hands in open air is just not human-compatible. But a lot of people at the time did think it was the future.

[cubefox]: Meanwhile, "cyberpunk" has been successfully trademarked in the US, even though it describes a literary genre. That's like someone trademarking "space opera", "romantasy", "film noir" etc.

[vessenes]: It's a somewhat liminal experience to walk with a famous sci-fi author through a tech conference; there are many, many callouts. Money is never sent in thanks for the inspo. The one that sticks out to me the most is Facebook rebranding to "Meta" -- Neal Stephenson coined the term in 1992. As far as I know, they never sent thanks in any form.

[koolala]: I'm glad it failed to trademark. Autodesk is one of the worst corpo's around when it comes to being corpo.  How un self-aware for them to make that 'street' joke. They were like a 100+ million company back then.
items.title: William Gibson and the trademarking of cyberspace

CFTC顾问阐释新「加密资产市场」框架：平台可自愿纳入联邦统一监管，行业是否跟进仍待观察

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，美国商品期货交易委员会主席 Mike Selig 高级顾问、创新工作组负责人 Michael Passalacqua 介绍称，在《Clarity 法案》受阻后，CFTC 推进的 Reg CAM 即「加密资产市场」框架，目标为加密资产交易平台提供自愿选项，纳入 CFTC 主导的全国统一监管。该安排主要面向向零售客户提供杠杆、保证金或融资交易的平台，使其可摆脱各州资金转移牌照拼凑的监管格局，纯现货、不带杠杆的交易一般仍不在这套强制框架内。

Passalacqua 表示，目标是给出一条联邦路径可选，但行业是否认为这是有吸引力的产品合规方式仍无定论。相关规则制定目前处于征求意见阶段。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372447
items.title: CFTC顾问阐释新「加密资产市场」框架：平台可自愿纳入联邦统一监管，行业是否跟进仍待观察

items.author: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton
items.content:
Richard Heart caught ‘off-guard,’ QDay gets even closer: Hodler’s Digest
HEX founder Richard Heart detained in early morning raid in Istanbul, Starknet plunges almost 50% as it votes to become an L1, and Bitwise says all signs point to Crypto Spring.
HEX erases $246 million in market cap after founder detained in Turkey
The HEX market cap fell from $561 million to $315 million this week after founder Richard Schueler — better known to the crypto community as Richard Heart — was detained by authorities in Istanbul on October 14.
Police seized $7.15 million in cash along with firearms and ammunition during an early morning raid in Istanbul’s Beşiktaş district, alongside searches of 15 related addresses according to Turkish Justice Minister Akın Gürlek.
Police impounded nine luxury vehicles registered to Schueler’s wife according to news agency Anadolu. The haul reportedly included 28 watches, 300 bags and 19 graphics cards.
Interpol issued a “Red Notice” for Schueler’s two years ago over allegations of tax fraud and assault, after Finnish authorities sought his arrest.
A spokesperson for Finland’s National Bureau of Investigations declined to comment on the matter.
Turkish media refer to Schueler as “Whale James” and have linked him to a $1 billion unregistered securities offering in the US. However that case was dismissed by a US judge in February 2025.
Images circulating in Turkish media appear to show a surprised Heart with no trousers on, and the bottom half of his body blurred out, provoking much merriment on social media. Vocal Hex critic Eric Wall, who has debated Schueler on video and social media, said he initially thought the image was AI generated but now believes it is real. (Cointelegraph can only verify the image is circulating not that it has not been altered.)
“i’m pretty much certain i died in a plane crash in 2015 and ever since that day i am still only alive in a fringe reality where everything is designed to be as funny as possible.”
Hex supporters claim that authorities are yet to confirm if Schueler has been formally arrested or charged.
Images circulating on Turkish media.
Ledger’s answer to wallet tampering costs $849 and ships next year
Ledger unveiled a new device on Thursday with stronger protections against tampering, days after confirming that wallets sold through a reseller in Asia contained malicious implants.
The French hardware wallet maker introduced Atom, an $849 device that combines a crypto wallet with everyday apps through a smartphone-like design. Atom separates Android apps from sensitive wallet operations and includes protections Ledger says would block the implants used in the recent Asia incident. It claims to detect tampering even when switched off.
Expected to become available in summer 2027, Atom will also support AI agent approvals, encrypted messaging and post-quantum cryptography.
Meanwhile a war of words has broken out between former Mt Gox CEO Mark Karpeles, and Ledger CEO Pascal Gauthier. Kapeles claims that at least two people notified Leger of spyware discovered inside  tampered Ledgers as far back as December 2025 — and notes the company had even written about the issue on its website in March 2026. He says the company failed to act properly to secure its reseller supply chains, which have now been suspended across Asia after more than $90 million was stolen.
Gauthier snarkily replied on X that Karpeles was “no white knight” and referred back to his failures in the lead up to the Mt Gox hack. 
Karpeles replied: 
“I was hoping you guys were better than that. I’ve been holding Ledger at a higher standard than what happened at MtGox, because I trusted you to do better by learning of my failure — to be better than me.”
QDay gets even closer as Starknet votes on becoming post quantum L1
Google has demonstrated a new process called “magic state cultivation” on its Willow quantum processor that reduces errors 40-fold. The technique achieved a record 99.99% accuracy rate for a specialized quantum state required to perform advanced calculations.
Meanwhile Theta Labs has posted three news quantum circuits that could reduce the number of qubits required to break elliptic curve cryptography by 28% from Google’s current estimate of 1,175 logical qubits.
With fears that AI is now getting so good at math that it may be able to break elliptic curve cryptography even before QDay arrives, Starknet has opened a vote to transform itself from an Ethereum L2 into a post quantum L1. StarkWare CEO Eli Ben-Sasson says that Ethereum’s post quantum roadmap may be too slow to meet the challenge from AI, meaning that Starknet needed to consider becoming a fully post quantum L1.
“Quantum-proofing crypto is urgent, so we must move at lightning speed,” he told Cointelegraph. More than 99% of votes cast to date are in favor of the move. Starknet’s token has lost almost 50% in value this week, after a big surge last week.
Standard Chartered pushes $2T stablecoin forecast to 2030 as EU embraces USDC
Standard Chartered says stablecoin transaction activity continues to grow even as the market’s overall value has stalled, suggesting existing stablecoins are circulating more frequently rather than new supply driving growth.
The bank said it now expects stablecoin market capitalization to reach $2 trillion by 2030, two years later than initially projected, after the market plateaued at roughly $309 billion this year.
Meanwhile the European Banking Authority has classified Circle’s USDC stablecoin as a significant e-money token under the region’s Markets in Crypto Assets (MiCA) framework. The classification has only been granted to 45 projects. 
Binance.US seeks $1B valuation in potential $100M funding round
Binance.US reportedly seeks to raise up to $100 million in a funding round that could value the cryptocurrency exchange at $1 billion.
According to a Thursday Bloomberg report, the US-based crypto exchange is pursuing private investment as it looks to expand its business. The potential $1 billion valuation would be well below the $4.5 billion pre-money valuation it secured in 2022, when it raised $200 million in seed funding.
Winners and Losers
At the end of the week, Bitcoin (BTC) is down 3.8% to trade at $81,484, Ethereum (ETH) is down 5.7% to trade at $2,386 and XRP (XRP) is down 8.3% to $1.28. The total market cap is at $2.72 trillion according to CoinMarketCap.
Among the biggest 100 cryptocurrencies, the top three altcoin winners of the week are Monero (XMR) with a 9.7% gain, Injective (INJ) on 5.6%, and Celestia (TIA) on 5.1%.
The top three altcoin losers of the week are Starknet (STRK) which was down 46.7%, Pump.fun (PUMP) down 27.1% and Raydium (RAY) down 26.5%.
Prediction of the Week
Bitwise’s Hougan says Q3 charts point to ‘crypto spring’
Bitwise chief investment officer Matt Hougan says Q3 may have been “one of the best quarters in crypto’s history,” arguing a sharp rebound in crypto prices and growing onchain markets point to the start of “crypto spring.”
In its quarterly market review published Thursday, Bitwise reported a 46.4% quarterly gain in its large-cap crypto index, along with $6 billion in US spot Bitcoin ETF inflows that brought year-to-date net flows back into positive territory.
“Page after page after page, it’s all the same: The most recent part of the chart is turning sharply upwards,” Hougan wrote. “That’s exactly what you want to see if you’re looking for the start of a crypto spring.”
Top FUD of the Week
MSCI adopts index exclusion rules that could oust Strategy
Index provider MSCI has adopted new rules that could lead to Strategy, Metaplanet and Upexi being removed from its global indexes, while leaving several other crypto treasury companies facing potential exclusion.
In August, Strategy opposed the changes but also played down the potential disruption, saying funds tracking MSCI’s Global Investable Market Indexes hold approximately 13 million shares, representing 3.1% of its basic shares outstanding. The company said those holdings amount to less than one day’s trading volume.
Russia to ban direct peer-to-peer crypto trades starting July 2027
Russia will ban direct peer-to-peer (P2P) cryptocurrency transactions between individuals starting next year, requiring individuals to use authorized intermediaries for such trades.
The regulator said the ban would come into place on July 1, 2027.
The regulator also clarified that individuals are not allowed to transfer crypto assets from their digital accounts to their own non-custodial, or self-custodial, wallets.
Ex-Trump crypto adviser profited after helping pass stablecoin bill: WSJ
Bo Hines, previously a crypto adviser to US President Donald Trump who later joined stablecoin issuer Tether, reportedly kept a stake in a company that profited from the passage of a stablecoin bill when he was still at the White House.
According to The Wall Street Journal, Hines had a one-third stake in the investment company he co-founded, Nxum, while pushing US lawmakers to pass the GENIUS Act. Nxum reportedly received $6.3 million as part of a deal with stablecoin issuer Tether, with the first payment going through while Hines was still serving in government.
